Content.SourceString: Hello，鉴定师！
Content.LocalizedString: Henlo, Appraiser!

Content.SourceString: 几天不见我的朋友，你好吗？~*
Content.LocalizedString: It's been a while, my fren. How you doin? ~*

Content.SourceString: 我挺好的，我比较担心你们那边具体怎么样了？
Content.LocalizedString: I'm good. I'm more concerned about Squad 6.

Content.SourceString: 起码我能这样来和你联系，已经证明了不少东西了吧？
Content.LocalizedString: At least I can contact you. That says a lot, right?

Content.SourceString: 也是！
Content.LocalizedString: True!

Content.SourceString: 虽然也很想在电话里交代清楚，或者直接通过电话把自己传送过来
Content.LocalizedString: I do want to tell you everything over the phone, or even teleport over there through it.

Content.SourceString: 不过因为有保密需求和一点点特殊状况，得给你添麻烦了
Content.LocalizedString: But because of confidentiality reasons and my special situation, I'll have to trouble you a bit.

Content.SourceString: 抱歉，我近期没法过去你那边……
Content.LocalizedString: Sorry, I won't be able to visit you for a while…

Content.SourceString: 我理解的……不如说……
Content.LocalizedString: I get it… In fact…

Content.SourceString: 我疑似已经不小心知道了太多不合适知道的机密了。
Content.LocalizedString: I already know too much confidential stuff beyond my clearance.

Content.SourceString: 所以再多知道一点点也差别不大啦hhhhh
Content.LocalizedString: So it dun matter if you knew even more, hahahahaha!

Content.SourceString: 你可以来管理局17F的「机房」吗？在那里见面聊吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Can you come see me at the server room? It's on the 17th floor of the Bureau.

Content.SourceString: 啊？机房？
Content.LocalizedString: Server room, huh?

Content.SourceString: 你莫非在想「机房这种地方，能充当会面室吗！？」
Content.LocalizedString: Are you thinking a server room can't be a presentable meeting room?

Content.SourceString: 确实一般不能~不过，这个机房可能和你想象的不太一样~
Content.LocalizedString: Well, you'd be right if it were a normal server room. But this one's different.

Content.SourceString: 好的？我很快就过去。
Content.LocalizedString: Ok, then. I'll be there soon.

Content.SourceString: 位置就在我们队伍的办公室旁边哦~*
Content.LocalizedString: It's located next to our squad's office!~*

Content.SourceString: 你好呀我的朋友~最近在忙吗？~*
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, my friend~ Have you been busy lately? ~*

Content.SourceString: 你好呀曳尔沐~我最近不忙，怎么了？
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, Elyms~ No, I haven't been too busy lately. What's up?

Content.SourceString: 发生了一件非常有趣的事想和你分享！
Content.LocalizedString: Something really interesting happened, and I want to share it with you!

Content.SourceString: 什么有趣的事？说来听听。
Content.LocalizedString: What's the story? Tell me

Content.SourceString: 嗨呀~
Content.LocalizedString: Ooh~

Content.SourceString: 真是让人感叹，大千世界，无奇不有……
Content.LocalizedString: The world really is full of surprises…

Content.SourceString: 还要卖关子吗？急急急。
Content.LocalizedString: Still keeping me in suspense? Hurry, hurry, tell me!

Content.SourceString: 要开启一个可以长聊的话题嘛
Content.LocalizedString: I wanna bring up a topic we can talk about for ages.

Content.SourceString: 这种时候，我都得好好铺垫一下怎么说
Content.LocalizedString: I always have to build up to it a little in moments like this, you know?

Content.SourceString: 讲故事要怎么讲得让人听起来觉得有意思，也有讲究的！
Content.LocalizedString: There's an art to telling a story in a way that keeps people interested!

Content.SourceString: 好吧，你酝酿酝酿，我等你打字。
Content.LocalizedString: Take a moment to gather your thoughts. I'll wait while you type.

Content.SourceString: 算啦
Content.LocalizedString: Never mind.

Content.SourceString: 不用等了鉴定师
Content.LocalizedString: No need to wait, Appraiser.

OptionText.LocalizedString: Weren't you going to tell me a story!?

Content.SourceString: 话说一半吊人胃口吗！？
Content.LocalizedString: You can't just leave me hanging like that!?

Content.SourceString: 我想，你有空的话就直接过来吧！来我们办公室
Content.LocalizedString: I was thinking, if you have time, just come by instead—come on over to our office!

Content.SourceString: 可惜啊！光靠通讯来表达东西，总免不了会有点折损呢
Content.LocalizedString: It's a shame! When you're trying to express something through messages alone, some of its meaning is bound to get lost.

Content.SourceString: 还是觉得让你直接看到它会比较好理解~
Content.LocalizedString: I still think it'll be easier to understand if you see it for yourself~

Content.SourceString: 嗯？那好吧，等我过来。
Content.LocalizedString: Huh? All right, fine, I'll head over.

Content.SourceString: 嗯？那好吧，等我过来。
Content.LocalizedString: Huh? All right, fine, I'll head over.

Content.SourceString: *helphelp*
Content.LocalizedString: *helphelp*

Content.SourceString: 有什么事需要帮忙吗？曳尔沐？
Content.LocalizedString: Need a hand with anything, Elyms?

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师你还记得小谜吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, do you remember Little Mysty?

Content.SourceString: 那只很有意思的，想和人类做朋友的谜皮鬼
Content.LocalizedString: The Mysty who wanted to be friends with humans?

Content.SourceString: 我记得，是那只很像模像样的假猫。
Content.LocalizedString: I remember. That fake cat was pretty convincing.

Content.SourceString: 哈哈哈哈，对
Content.LocalizedString: Hahaha, yeah.

Content.SourceString: 现在有个可能只能拜托你的事情
Content.LocalizedString: There's something that I think only you can help me with.

Content.SourceString: 昨天小谜说想散散心，我就放它去公园当会儿野猫了，跟它说了今天白天去接它的
Content.LocalizedString: Yesterday, Little Mysty said it wanted to clear its head, so I let it roam around the park like a stray for a while. I told it I'd come pick it up during the day today.

Content.SourceString: 可是出了一点意外，导致我现在没有办法去接它了
Content.LocalizedString: But something unexpected came up, so I can't go and pick it up.

Content.SourceString: 出了什么意外？
Content.LocalizedString: What happened?

Content.SourceString: 刚巧~
Content.LocalizedString: As luck would have it~

Content.SourceString: 我被杀了
Content.LocalizedString: I got killed.

Content.SourceString: ……好吧，知道是什么情况了。
Content.LocalizedString: …Okay, I suppose I understand.

Content.SourceString: 不用担心，加急再生成中~*
Content.LocalizedString: Don't worry, my regeneration's being fast-tracked~*

Content.SourceString: 今晚应该能修好的，到时我很快就过来
Content.LocalizedString: I should be right as rain by tonight. I'll come over then.

Content.SourceString: 在那之前，小谜可以拜托你一下吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Until then, could you look after Little Mysty for me?

Content.SourceString: OK，我去找找它。
Content.LocalizedString: Alright, I'll go look for it.

Content.SourceString: 麻烦你了！谢谢><
Content.LocalizedString: Thanks for doing this! ><

Content.SourceString: 麻烦你了！谢谢><
Content.LocalizedString: Thanks for doing this! ><

Content.SourceString: *发送邀请*
Content.LocalizedString: *Sends an invitation*

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，你来和小谜道个别吗？在车站这里
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, would you like to come say goodbye to Little Mysty? We're at the station.

Content.SourceString: 你是它在这段时间唯二说得上话的朋友，它也很惦记你
Content.LocalizedString: You're one of the only two friends it's been able to talk to during this time, and it misses you, too.

Content.SourceString: 难道……找到它的主人了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: So… did you find its owner?

Content.SourceString: 没有「找到」哦~
Content.LocalizedString: We didn't exactly "find" them~

Content.SourceString: 因为，虽然一回来就被拜托了由我来帮忙寻找失主，但其实我没有在找的~
Content.LocalizedString: Because, even though I was asked to help look for its former owner as soon as I got back, I wasn't actually looking~

Content.SourceString: 一通额外的电话我都没有打过
Content.LocalizedString: I didn't make a single extra call.

OptionText.LocalizedString: Was it because of Little Mysty's behavior?

Content.SourceString: 是因为小谜它当时还在闹别扭，主观意愿上并不想回去吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Was it because Little Mysty was still sulking back then and didn't want to go back?

Content.SourceString: 不全是
Content.LocalizedString: Not entirely.

Content.SourceString: 也因为，这是对前主人的「测试」~*
Content.LocalizedString: It was also a "test" for its former "owner"~*

Content.SourceString: 在只撒下零星线索的情况下，如果她能为了小谜，打出一通又一通电话
Content.LocalizedString: If she could make call after call in search of Little Mysty, with only a few scattered clues to go on,

Content.SourceString: 顺着设置好的谜题成功「找来」管理局，自己找到小谜所在之处的话
Content.LocalizedString: and follow the clues I laid out all the way to the Bureau, finding Little Mysty herself…

Content.SourceString: 我就有充分的论据告诉它——
Content.LocalizedString: Then I'd have solid evidence to tell Little Mysty—

Content.SourceString: 不是可以用再买一只猫去随时替换的「宠物」，而是被当成了「朋友」呢
Content.LocalizedString: "You weren't just a 'pet' she could replace anytime by buying another cat. You were her 'friend'."

Content.SourceString: 原来如此啊……
Content.LocalizedString: I see…

Content.SourceString: 属于「猫主人」和「谜之猫咪」的存档单元，要破解完成了哦！~
Content.LocalizedString: We're almost done cracking the Archive Unit for the "Cat Owner" and the "Mystery Cat"!~

Content.SourceString: 我这就来！
Content.LocalizedString: I'm coming right now!

Content.SourceString: 我这就来！
Content.LocalizedString: I'm coming right now!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师~！
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser~!

Content.SourceString: 现在闲吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Are you free right now?

Content.SourceString: 闲！
Content.LocalizedString: I am.

Content.SourceString: *申请聊天*
Content.LocalizedString: *Chat Request*

Content.SourceString: 接受。
Content.LocalizedString: Yep!

Content.SourceString: 聊什么呢？
Content.LocalizedString: What do you wanna talk about?

OptionText.LocalizedString: What do you wanna talk about?

Content.SourceString: 聊什么呢？
Content.LocalizedString: What do you wanna talk about?

Content.SourceString: 你问我吗？
Content.LocalizedString: You're asking me?

Content.SourceString: 诶嘿因为还没有想好就来找你了呀！
Content.LocalizedString: Hehe, I came to chat with you before I'd figured out what to talk about!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师想聊什么话题呢？
Content.LocalizedString: What would you like to talk about, Appraiser?

Content.SourceString: 我也没想好啊，太突然了……
Content.LocalizedString: I haven't thought of anything either. This whole conversation was a bit sudden…
Um…

Content.SourceString: 那这次就算了吧！~*
Content.LocalizedString: Then let's just leave it for now!~*

Content.SourceString: 我有数啦，下次我准备好话题再来找你！
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, I've got it! Next time, I'll come find you once I've thought of something to talk about!

Content.SourceString: 原来如此，是在摸索我的聊天习惯之类的东西吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, I see—you're trying to figure out how I like to chat, huh?

Content.SourceString: 哎呀，别说得好像是任务一样嘛^▽^
Content.LocalizedString: Aww, don't make it sound like some kind of quest! ^▽^

Content.SourceString: 这类把握，更多是在自然而然的交谈过程中浮现的认识，没有哪种特定的说法只是为了这一目的~
Content.LocalizedString: You get a feel for those things naturally when talking to someone—I don't say things just to figure someone out~

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师有没有看过类似这样的电影？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, have you ever seen a movie like this?

Content.SourceString: 要成为演员的女孩……像梦境一样迷幻的故事……~*
Content.LocalizedString: A girl who wants to become an actress… a story as surreal as a dream…~*

Content.SourceString: 「蓝色」在影片中作为重要的意象……
Content.LocalizedString: The color "blue" is an important motif in the film…

Content.SourceString: 励志片吗？
Content.LocalizedString: So, it's an inspirational movie?

Content.SourceString: 呃，不能说完全没有讲事业的部分？
Content.LocalizedString: Well, I wouldn't say there's absolutely nothing about the girl's career in it…?

Content.SourceString: 不过总体是偏心理恐怖的~
Content.LocalizedString: But overall, it leans more towards psychological horror~

Content.SourceString: 心理恐怖啊……我好像不怎么看这种类型。
Content.LocalizedString: Psychological horror… I don't think I watch those kinds of movies very often.

Content.SourceString: 心理恐怖啊……我还挺有兴趣的。
Content.LocalizedString: Psychological horror… I'm actually pretty interested in that genre.

Content.SourceString: 我对于某些电影中对蓝色的运用方式很感兴趣呢~
Content.LocalizedString: I'm actually pretty fascinated by how some films utilize the color blue to evoke certain emotions…

Content.SourceString: 一般的恐怖电影，主要是靠猩红的感觉来营造不妙的氛围吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Horror movies usually rely on red tones to create an ominous atmosphere, right?

Content.SourceString: 但是纯净到像是不存于自然界的深蓝色，也具有某种莫名让人感到强烈不安的冲击力
Content.LocalizedString: But a deep blue—too pure for nature—can also elicit an unsettling feeling.

Content.SourceString: 你这么一说，确实感觉深蓝色是也可以挺恐怖的……
Content.LocalizedString: Now that you mention it, I suppose a blue like that would be pretty scary…

Content.SourceString: 不过突然研究起这个，难道是在……
Content.LocalizedString: But why are you suddenly researching all this? Could it be…

Content.SourceString: 是在？
Content.LocalizedString: Are you…?

OptionText.LocalizedString: Picking out a gift for a friend?

Content.SourceString: 装修房间？
Content.LocalizedString: Renovating your room?

Content.SourceString: 给朋友挑礼物？
Content.LocalizedString: Picking out a gift for a friend?

Content.SourceString: 被你猜到了！
Content.LocalizedString: You guessed it!

Content.SourceString: 我想根据那部电影中的调调，做一个蓝色的小盒子和一把对应的蓝色钥匙~
Content.LocalizedString: I want to make a little blue box and a matching blue key inspired by the movie's vibe~

OptionText.LocalizedString: What are you going to put inside the box?

Content.SourceString: 里面要装什么？
Content.LocalizedString: What are you going to put inside the box?

Content.SourceString: 嗯哼~那是秘密咯！
Content.LocalizedString: Hehe~ That's a secret!

Content.SourceString: 以前的通话设备，鉴定师是不是没怎么见过？
Content.LocalizedString: Have you ever seen the older style of phones, Appraiser?

Content.SourceString: 我的第一部手机，就是阿德勒先生给我的现代智能手机了。
Content.LocalizedString: My first phone was the modern smartphone Mr. Adler gave me.

Content.SourceString: 所以确实不知道以前的手机是什么样子。
Content.LocalizedString: So I don't know what older phones were actually like.

Content.SourceString: 翻盖手机很棒哦！很棒的~(?ω`)
Content.LocalizedString: Flip phones are great! They're so cute~(?ω`)

Content.SourceString: 打开盖子的时候，有「咯哒！」的手感！
Content.LocalizedString: You can feel that satisfying little "click!" when you flip it open!

Content.SourceString: 敲击按键的时候，有「嘟嘟！」的手感！
Content.LocalizedString: And pressing the keys is so satisfying—beep, beep!

Content.SourceString: 就算并没有给谁写短信的预订，有时候也会想要拿出来凭空按上几下！
Content.LocalizedString: Even when I'm not planning on texting anyone, sometimes I just like to take it out and press the buttons for fun!

Content.SourceString: 有按键的话可能操作起来还更方便？
Content.LocalizedString: Would it maybe be easier to use if it had physical buttons?

Content.SourceString: 是啊，相较之下，屏幕上的虚拟键盘看不见就很难操作了
Content.LocalizedString: Yeah, compared to a physical keypad, an on-screen keyboard is hard to use if you can't see it.

Content.SourceString: 就算眼睛没有看着，也可以在上课的时候塞在桌洞里，通过盲打来偷偷写短信哦！
Content.LocalizedString: You could keep it tucked in your desk during class and secretly type out a message without even looking!

Content.SourceString: 以前大家都用这种方法摸鱼聊天呢~*
Content.LocalizedString: Everyone used to secretly message each other in class this way~

Content.SourceString: 而且比起现在的智能手机更加适合装配挂饰！
Content.LocalizedString: And they were way easier to accessorize with phone charms than today's smartphones!

Content.SourceString: 那时候大家的手机拿出来，经常能看到各种闪闪发亮的漂亮挂件
Content.LocalizedString: Back then, whenever people took out their phones, you'd often see all kinds of pretty, glittering charms hanging from them.

Content.SourceString: 以前很流行吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Were they popular back then?

Content.SourceString: 说是以前，其实也有很多人觉得就是不久之前的事呢……
Content.LocalizedString: You might call it "the past", but a lot of people still feel like it wasn't all that long ago…

Content.SourceString: 科技设备的更新换代实在太快啦……每过几年就是一个新样子
Content.LocalizedString: Tech changes so fast… Every few years, everything looks different.

Content.SourceString: 大多也已经都停产了
Content.LocalizedString: Most of those kinds of phones have been discontinued by now.

Content.SourceString: 听起来有点寂寞啊……
Content.LocalizedString: That sounds a little lonely…

Content.SourceString: 那也是没办法的事，不过不用担心~
Content.LocalizedString: Well, it can't be helped. But don't worry~

Content.SourceString: 也有很多人，依然坚定不移地热爱着像老电脑和老手机这样「过气」的东西？
Content.LocalizedString: There are still plenty of people who are devoted to things considered "outdated," like old computers and old phones.

Content.SourceString: 怀旧情结吗……
Content.LocalizedString: Nostalgia, maybe…

Content.SourceString: 有时候，那也不是单纯的迷恋旧物，而是「好想回去那时/那里」的心情投射吧……
Content.LocalizedString: Sometimes, it's not just about liking old things. It's about wishing you could go back to that time, or that place…

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师~*
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser~*

Content.SourceString: 我看到呗果上的大家在聊一件很好玩儿的事情诶
Content.LocalizedString: I saw everyone on Bagel talking about something really interesting!

Content.SourceString: 是都市传说吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Was it an urban legend?

Content.SourceString: 是心理测试吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Was it a personality test?

Content.SourceString: 那倒不是哦！
Content.LocalizedString: No, not quite!

Content.SourceString: 【讨论帖】搬家的时候整理出了小时候的玩具，回忆一口气涌上来……
Content.LocalizedString: [Discussion Post] While sorting things during a move, I found some toys from my childhood, and all these memories suddenly came flooding back…

Content.SourceString: 是大约……现在年龄在上班工作阶段的网民朋友们，在聊自己童年玩具的话题~
Content.LocalizedString: It's about… people who are roughly of working age now, chatting about the toys they had as kids~

Content.SourceString: 滚铁环……这个是怎么玩的？
Content.LocalizedString: Rolling a hoop… how does that work?

Content.SourceString: 竹蜻蜓……看起来好简单的构造。
Content.LocalizedString: A bamboo-copter… It looks like it has a pretty simple design.

Content.SourceString: 很有独属于一个时代的共鸣的感觉吧？
Content.LocalizedString: It gives people from that era a special feeling of shared nostalgia, doesn't it?

Content.SourceString: 虽然加入讨论的大家都在说着「好熟悉啊」「好怀念啊」「看了感觉年轻了二十岁」什么的……
Content.LocalizedString: Though everyone who joined the discussion was saying things like, "That feels so familiar," "So nostalgic," and "I feel twenty years younger just looking at it"…

Content.SourceString: 但是对于现在的小朋友，以及像鉴定师这样一片白纸的人来说，反而像是看到某种新奇东西一样吧？
Content.LocalizedString: But for kids today—and for someone like you, Appraiser, starting from a blank slate—it probably feels like discovering something totally new, right?

Content.SourceString: 但是曳尔沐应该也一样没见过吧？
Content.LocalizedString: But you've never seen one either, have you, Elyms?

Content.SourceString: 哎呀，你可以说我的童心很符合我的实在「年龄」，但可不能真的把我当成人类的三岁小孩哦？
Content.LocalizedString: Come on, you can say my childlike whimsy suits my actual "age," but don't go treating me like a three-year-old, okay?

Content.SourceString: 这些东西也经常承载着人们对童年朋友的美好感情，所以时常会从那片海里找到的
Content.LocalizedString: These things often carry people's affection for their childhood friends, too, so they turn up in that sea a lot.

Content.SourceString: 现在的玩具也越出越花哨，很难想象还会推出看起来这么简洁的玩具了
Content.LocalizedString: Toys these days keep getting more elaborate. It's hard to imagine anyone still making one that looks this simple.

Content.SourceString: 是啊~这已经可以说是上上个时代的产物了，因为和绝迹了差不多，反而显得很珍贵。
Content.LocalizedString: Yeah~ You could say it's a relic from an era before last. It's practically vanished by now, which makes it all the more precious.

Content.SourceString: 时间真快啊，上时代的游戏设备，也在渐渐落下帷幕……
Content.LocalizedString: Time flies… The gaming consoles of the previous era are on their last legs…

Content.SourceString: 而接下来的时代的小朋友们，可能很多都可以直接上手玩着画质很高、场景很大的那种3D电子游戏来度过童年时光了呢！
Content.LocalizedString: And a lot of kids in the next generation might get to spend their childhoods playing gorgeous 3D video games with huge, sprawling worlds!

Content.SourceString: 那么，再下一个时代会是什么呢？
Content.LocalizedString: So what will the era after that be like?

Content.SourceString: 猜不到呀！
Content.LocalizedString: I can't even begin to guess!

Content.SourceString: 所以才好期待啊~「未来」 ……
Content.LocalizedString: That's what makes the "future" so exciting~

Content.SourceString: 啊对了对了！
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, right, right!

Content.SourceString: 我和队员们说了要住院，所以有段时间不会露面，如果他们说起的话也要麻烦鉴定师统一口径了~*
Content.LocalizedString: I told my teammates I'd be hospitalized, so I'd be out for a while. If they ask you, help me keep our story straight, Appraiser~*

Content.SourceString: 好的，我会统一口径。
Content.LocalizedString: Sure, I'll stand by the script.

Content.SourceString: 多谢，真是给你添了好多麻烦！><
Content.LocalizedString: Thanks so much! Sorry for being such a bother! ><

Content.SourceString: 而且再怎么说，这矛盾一般来说也确实不应该牵扯进其他人的。
Content.LocalizedString: Besides, this kind of conflict shouldn't involve anyone else.

Content.SourceString: 不算牵扯，我是接了委托后主动接触和进来的。
Content.LocalizedString: I wouldn't say I was dragged into it. I chose to reach out and get involved after taking it.

Content.SourceString: 不算牵扯，我本来就有意来调查都市传说真相的。
Content.LocalizedString: I wouldn't say I was dragged into it. I was already planning on looking into the truth behind the urban legend.

Content.SourceString: 你疑似有点太好说话咯？这样可是会令人担心的！
Content.LocalizedString: You might be a little too accommodating, you know? That could make people worry!

Content.SourceString: 唉，其实以前还是我和Exe提的文明杀人协议
Content.LocalizedString: Ah… Actually, I was the one who proposed the civilized murder pact to Exe back then.

Content.SourceString: 文明……杀人？这是竟然是能连在一起用的词吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Civilized… murder? What kind of oxymoron is that?

Content.SourceString: 哈哈内容大致就是：要杀的话就只在我们两个中间决胜负，别影响到我的其他朋友们
Content.LocalizedString: Haha, the gist was: if we were gonna kill each other, we'd settle it between the two of us and keep our other friends out of it.

Content.SourceString: 当然他那边也本来就差不多是这么想的，于是就一拍即合地立下了这样的约定
Content.LocalizedString: Of course, he was already thinking pretty much the same thing, so we quickly came to an agreement.

Content.SourceString: 但这次靠稍微耍了一下文字游戏，小小地作了弊去强行赢他的，还是我这边啊~
Content.LocalizedString: But this time, I was the one who twisted the wording, cheated just a tiny bit, and forced a win over him~

OptionText.LocalizedString: Good thing you used that trick of yours.

Content.SourceString: 还好你用了这招，不然结局……从各个角度来说，都太坏了。
Content.LocalizedString: Good thing you did. Otherwise, the ending… would've been awful in every way.

Content.SourceString: 真狡猾啊，但这也是为了起码避免掉那个各方面都一坏到底的结局。
Content.LocalizedString: Pretty sneaky of you, but at least it kept us from a terrible ending.

Content.SourceString: 那个坏结局吗……
Content.LocalizedString: That terrible ending…

Content.SourceString: 你就没有一瞬间想过——他的观点有道理，我或许真的应该被泯除掉吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Did you ever think, even for a moment, that he might have a point—that maybe I really should be Nullified?

Content.SourceString: 那你自己会这么想吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Do you really believe that about yourself?

Content.SourceString: 他在完全理解过我是一个什么样的东西之后，坚决且激烈地否定我
Content.LocalizedString: He knew exactly what kind of thing I was, and he still rejected me fiercely and without hesitation.

Content.SourceString: 而我也完全理解他的角度呢，你可以认为，我确实觉得他有道理？
Content.LocalizedString: Honestly, I can completely understand where he's coming from. You could even say I think he has a point.

Content.SourceString: 但理解对方和自己要做什么决定，终究是两码事，我决定了不放弃我的存在~
Content.LocalizedString: But understanding where someone else is coming from and deciding what to do yourself are two entirely different things. I've decided not to give up on my existence~

Content.SourceString: 我才不要输掉呢，从很多很多的意义上，我都绝不能被他轻轻松松就赢过了~*
Content.LocalizedString: I'm not gonna lose! In more ways than one, I can't let him win that easily~*

Content.SourceString: 这人既然怎么走都已经只剩坏结局了，那至少，为他选择稍微有趣一点的那个！
Content.LocalizedString: If all his paths lead to bad endings anyway, I might as well pick a slightly more interesting one for him!

Content.SourceString: 就只能从坏结局和更坏的结局中选啊……？
Content.LocalizedString: So it's really just a choice between a bad ending and an even worse one…?

Content.SourceString: 或许也有一个好结局？那就是他先败给我——覆写成功？
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe there's a good ending, too? One where he loses to me first—and the overwrite succeeds?

Content.SourceString: 哇哦！一觉睡醒发现，「Y」不光没有死，现在还真的和自己成为了工作上的搭档呢~？之类的
Content.LocalizedString: Whoa! Imagine waking up one morning and finding that "Y" not only survived but actually ended up as your coworker, too~? Something like that.

Content.SourceString: 好结局（存疑？）
Content.LocalizedString: A good ending… really?

Content.SourceString: 哈哈……确实感觉，是比坏结局还要诡异的好结局啊
Content.LocalizedString: Haha… yeah, it feels like a good ending is even stranger than a bad one.
Ah…

Content.SourceString: 或许当前能有的相对最妥当的路线，也就是暂时不去迎来确切的结局咯~
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe the most reasonable course for now is to temporarily put off reaching a definite ending for either of us~

Content.SourceString: 心情复杂啊……
Content.LocalizedString: I have mixed feelings…

Content.SourceString: 是呢
Content.LocalizedString: Yeah.

Content.SourceString: 话说，Exe有向你道过歉了么？
Content.LocalizedString: By the way, has Exe apologized to you yet?

Content.SourceString: 没有呢，他要向我道歉吗？
Content.LocalizedString: No. Is he supposed to apologize to me?

Content.SourceString: 当初从异象空间踢我下线的时候，稍微道了一下下歉。后面就没了。
Content.LocalizedString: He gave me a quick apology when he kicked me out of the Anomalous Realm. That was it.

Content.SourceString: 果然啊！#
Content.LocalizedString: I knew it!#

Content.SourceString: 再怎么说，身为E.T.D却攻击了市民也是事实……
Content.LocalizedString: Still, the fact remains that an ETD member attacked a civilian…

Content.SourceString: 我会再督促他尽快来向你道歉的！真是不好意思！当然，你接不接受都可以！
Content.LocalizedString: I'll keep pushing him to apologize to you as soon as possible! I'm really sorry about all this! Of course, whether you accept his apology is entirely up to you!

Content.SourceString: 我描述一下情况，不是帮他说话……
Content.LocalizedString: Let me explain what happened. I'm not defending him, but…

Content.SourceString: 他是在场地下面设置了一个陷阱把我困住……为了避免我继续绊着他。看得出来下手有所保留。
Content.LocalizedString: He set a trap beneath the ground there to catch me… so I couldn't keep getting in his way. You could tell he was holding back.

Content.SourceString: 实际上也是把我引导到那个位置，再让我掉进去，限制住了我的行动，我并没有受很重的伤就是了。
Content.LocalizedString: Basically, he led me to that spot, then dropped me into the trap. I couldn't move at all, though I wasn't badly injured.

Content.SourceString: 嗯嗯，我猜也是那么处理的。只是再怎么说，总得有个交代呀~
Content.LocalizedString: Mm-hmm, I figured that was how he handled it too. Still, he owes you an explanation, at the very least~

Content.SourceString: 虽然他并不在意被别人怎么想，但维护我们队伍在他人眼中的形象，也算是我的工作
Content.LocalizedString: He doesn't care what other people think of him, but maintaining our team's image is a part of my job.

Content.SourceString: 如果纯由着用这种交流风格去干，不及时跟在后面补救的话，我们队伍在外头的风评分分钟就完蛋了
Content.LocalizedString: If I let him carry on like that, our team's reputation would be in the mud in no time.

OptionText.LocalizedString: Thanks for all your hard work…

Content.SourceString: 各方各面，都辛苦你了……
Content.LocalizedString: You've really had your hands full with everything…

Content.SourceString: 各方各面，你都真不容易啊……
Content.LocalizedString: You've really had it rough lately…

Content.SourceString: 还好还好，难题有太多已经只能被晾在一边喽
Content.LocalizedString: It's all good, it's all good. There are just too many problems to deal with right now, so some have to go on the back burner~

Content.SourceString: 在那之中，靠与人通讯交流就能处理的部分，对我来说都是小意思而已啦~*
Content.LocalizedString: Anything I can sort out just by talking things through with people is a piece of cake for me~*

Content.SourceString: 出入我的异象空间，都要将身体数据化传送过去再生成，对你还是很有负担的吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Going in and out of my Anomalous Realm means your body has to be digitized, transported over, and reconstructed. That must be pretty taxing for you, right?

Content.SourceString: Exe习惯了好像没什么感觉，不过除此之外也没有其他人类进过我的异象空间了……
Content.LocalizedString: Exe's gotten used to the process, so he's not bothered by it much anymore. However, no other human besides him has ever entered my Anomalous Realm…

Content.SourceString: 所以我也不太确定，你会不会有什么不舒服？
Content.LocalizedString: So, how are you feeling? Are you uncomfortable at all?

Content.SourceString: 当时是有点，晕晕的不太适应……不过现在没事。
Content.LocalizedString: I was a little dizzy, but I'm fine now.

Content.SourceString: 呼~那就好~
Content.LocalizedString: Whew… That's good~
